description: Header file defining the VsockCameraServer class, which manages a server for camera communication over vsock connections in an Android hardware camera provider implementation.

classes.name: VsockCameraServer
classes.description: A class that manages a vsock-based camera server, handling connection setup, server loop, and callback management.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Returns whether the server is currently running.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server on the specified port and CID.

methods.name: setConnectedCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function to be invoked upon a new connection.

methods.name: serverLoop
methods.description: Internal method that runs the server loop accepting connections.
